notes.title: SHOOPER NOVA S4 Update Preview
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, thank you for your support for SHOOPER NOVA :3, the S4 Season update is coming soon!

(Note: Due to difficulty adjustments and data changes, to ensure fairness and enjoyment of the Ranking,**old game save data will become invalid after the update**)



Here are the main update contents:

New Final Battle: After passing Wave 20, a "Final Battle" option is added. Enter an untimed Wave 21, challenge yourself to survive longer and rank (this will use a separate Ranking leaderboard, this option will take less time).

New Custom Emoji: You can now import local images and display them on your character's face (supports PNG and GIF image formats).

Trading Cards Enabled: (Cards, Badges, Emotes, Profile Backgrounds, Animated Avatars; it is said that veteran players will be compensated with dropped cards).

Steam Workshop Enabled.

Please look forward to more content in the update announcement on the release day :3!

notes.title: SHOOPER NOVA: Upcoming Update Preview
notes.notes:
SHOOPER NOVA is about to receive an update!

  Enhanced the power of Weapons/Shields/Towers/Scattering/Negative Refinement, and Satellites will become "bigger"
  Enhanced the importance of Component Levels in mid-to-late game
  Component Archive can view components of various levels
  Added 【Enemy Archive】
  Added 【Endless Proving Ground】, which does not participate in ranking, enemies grow slower, Tech cap is doubled, allowing for exploration of more possibilities
  Original 【Endless Trial】 renamed to 【Extreme Challenge】
  Prevent damage loss under low frame rates
  Ranking will enter S3 Season!（Note：Save data for unfinished games will become invalid after the update）

notes.title: SHOOPER NOVA Future Update Plan! Update Roadmap
notes.notes:
Update Roadmap

Performance Optimization

 Continue optimizing mid-to-late game performance.


Shop Experience

 Ability to view and unban items disabled in the current run.
 Intuitive visualization of satellite orbits in the shop.


Combat Experience

 Adjustable projectile effect transparency.
 Improved cursor visibility.


Encyclopedia Enhancements

 Monster Encyclopedia.
 Component Encyclopedia will display different component levels.


Buffs for Weaker Builds

 Strengthen Firearms.
 Strengthen Shields.
 Strengthen Shooting Turrets.


Extreme Challenge & Endless Mode
Choice available after Wave 20:

 Extreme Challenge: Higher difficulty, includes rank.
 Endless Mode: Lower difficulty, no rank, removes tech stacking cap.
 Finish Run.


New Features & Workshop

 New Gameplay Mode.
 Controller vibration feedback.
 Key Binding.
 Custom player emotes.
 Steam Workshop Support.


Wallpaper

 Wallpaper Engine audio-responsive wallpaper.
